title: lem-pc-closed-structure-tensor-projection
statement: Let i:Z→Y be a closed immersion of schemes [def-pc-scheme]. Let B=i_*O_Z, as an O_Y-module sheaf. Using the sheaf tensor product [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product] and the recorded tensor pullback [def-pc-module-pullback], the functor M↦M tensor B from Mod(O_Y) to itself is naturally isomorphic to i^* followed by i_*. This applies to all module sheaves, without flatness or quasi-coherence.

proof.text: Use the canonical tensor-pullback adjunction unit to define the section pairing (s,r) ↦ r times unit(s). Verify bilinearity by linearity of the unit and commuting scalar actions, and verify restriction compatibility by naturality of the unit and semilinearity of restrictions. The tensor bilinear universal property gives a unique component map.

Prove naturality on pure tensor sections using adjunction-unit naturality and O_Z-linearity of tensorPullback.map. Extend the equality to the sheaf tensor maps: precompose the tensor/sheafification isomorphism, apply injectivity of the sheafification Hom equivalence, and induct on presheaf tensors. This assembles the components into a natural transformation.

Apply the local stalk calculation to the constructed component map and its section formula at every point. The Mathlib stalk criterion for abelian sheaves and reflection of isomorphisms by the forgetful functor give invertibility of each module map; NatIso.ofComponents assembles them.

theorem nonempty_closedStructure_tensor_projection
    {Z Y : Scheme.{u}} (i : Z ⟶ Y) [IsClosedImmersion i] :
    letI := SheafOfModules.monoidalCategory Y.sheaf
    let B := (Scheme.Modules.pushforward i).obj (SheafOfModules.unit Z.ringCatSheaf)
    Nonempty ((tensorRight B : SheafOfModules.{u} Y.ringCatSheaf ⥤
      SheafOfModules.{u} Y.ringCatSheaf) ≅
      Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback i ⋙ Scheme.Modules.pushforward i)
